# Introduction

This book is a collection of mathematical fundamentals and techniques for theoretical physics, particularly those centered around and related to electromagnetism.

Currently, this book is split into two parts: the principles of physics and the relevant methods of mathematics in physics.

This book is organised and written with the objective to do two things: First, to bridge the mathematics for theoretical physics with mathematical fundamentals, and second, to explain physics from first principles.
